set_default_hook_class: set the default hook class for the SPDL pipeline to a custom hook implementation
get_default_hook_class: get the current default hook class configured for the SPDL pipeline
set_default_queue_class: set the default queue class for the SPDL pipeline to a custom queue implementation
get_default_queue_class: get the current default queue class configured for the SPDL pipeline
is_diagnostic_mode_enabled: check if diagnostic mode is currently enabled in the SPDL pipeline configuration
